# JDS SOMMER GmbH

> JDS SOMMER converts existing drawings, scans and point clouds into precise,
> editable 2D CAD files and 3D/BIM models. Based in Frankfurt am Main, with more
> than 40 years of engineering experience. Website in German (default) and English.

## Core services
- [2D CAD Digitalisation](https://www.jds-sommer.de/en/2d-cad-digitizing)
- [3D & BIM Modelling](https://www.jds-sommer.de/en/3d-bim-modeling)
- [3D CAD & Reverse Engineering](https://www.jds-sommer.de/en/3d-cad-reverse-engineering)
- [As-Built & Facility Documentation](https://www.jds-sommer.de/en/as-built-facility-documentation)
- [GIS & Infrastructure Data](https://www.jds-sommer.de/en/gis-infrastructure-data)

## More
